vo.en: You can’t move your pinky. Ready?

visual.description: A close-up of a man's hand placed firmly and flat on a dark wooden desk.

vo.en: Put your hand flat and fold your middle finger all the way under.

visual.description: Macro shot of a finger joint bending inward until the knuckle touches the table surface.

vo.en: Keep your other fingers pressed down and try to lift your pinky finger.

visual.description: The hand strains as the person attempts to lift their small finger while others remain pinned.

vo.en: But here is the creepy part. Your hand is physically locked.

visual.description: A blue 3D medical animation showing the internal tendons of a human hand.

vo.en: Your ring and pinky fingers are physically linked by a single shared tendon.

visual.description: Two heavy industrial ropes intertwined and pulling against each other under tension.

vo.en: When that middle finger is pinned, it anchors the connection, trapping your pinky.

visual.description: A heavy metal mechanical bolt snapping into a locked position on a machine.

vo.en: Only the rare one percent can move it. Subscribe for daily brain tests and comment YES if it worked, which is exactly why

visual.description: A man's thumb scrolling through a phone screen and tapping the comment section.
